description: MainActivity.kt is the primary activity source file for the Android application. It defines the user interface logic for a simple login and calculator app, including view bindings, event handling, authentication (in-memory), and basic arithmetic computations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity handling login, registration, and calculator functionalities. Manages views, user authentication, and arithmetic operations within the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets event handlers, pre-seeds a demo account, and displays the login screen.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates UI elements with their respective view IDs.

methods.name: wireEvents
methods.description: Sets click listeners for buttons to handle navigation and operations.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Displays the dashboard UI with welcome message after login.

methods.name: clearAuthErrors
methods.description: Hides error messages related to authentication.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates credentials against in-memory accounts and navigates to dashboard on success.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Registers a new account if inputs are valid and navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: clearCalculatorState
methods.description: Resets calculator inputs and hides error messages.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic calculations based on selected operation.

methods.name: parseDoubleOrNull
methods.description: Parses a string into a Double, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a double to string, removing unnecessary decimal for integers.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Performs basic validation to check if an email string looks valid.
